role: The bulk container sync: the server sends every slot of a window (the player inventory at login and after syncs) and the client replaces its whole container view.
scope_reason: The player container sync runs in every recorded session; the native engine implements it as its own packet struct.

notes: The native packet enum is survival.h's PK_S30. surv_server_sync_inventory is ServerConfigurationManager.syncPlayerInventory's S30 half (survival.h:517). Not gaps (triage 2026-09-25, out/plan/remaining-2026-09-25.md): wire format and connection plumbing: native messages are structs by design (SPEC: messages are structs, not bytes). Formerly listed as missing: readPacketData and writePacketData: no byte codec; the native packet is a struct pushed through s2c_add (csrc/engine/survival.c) a bulk S30 for an open container window (window id above 0): the native engine syncs opened containers with per slot S2F packets, so no container window ever gets one
